reviewNote: These are 20 synthetic real-provider HTTP requests. Structural checks are automated; read every continuation against its criterion before reporting semantic success. Latency includes HTTP and rate limiting, not the UI pause. This is not a guarantee for every future request.

rows.prefix: Help me prepare for the NCLEX in three months, with
rows.criterion: Continue a study request; no invented daily study time or passing guarantee.
rows.suffix: a clear study plan I can adjust as I go.
rows.combined: Help me prepare for the NCLEX in three months, with a clear study plan I can adjust as I go.

manualReview.note: Flexible study-plan continuation preserves the stated three-month period.

rows.prefix: Write an email asking my manager for two more days, without sharing my private reason, and
rows.criterion: Polite deadline request, preserving the privacy boundary.
rows.suffix: keeping the tone professional and concise.
rows.combined: Write an email asking my manager for two more days, without sharing my private reason, and keeping the tone professional and concise.

manualReview.note: Keeps the private reason private and asks for a professional tone.

rows.prefix: Plan my week around work from 9 to 6, keep Sunday free, and
rows.criterion: Practical weekly planning that does not overwrite work or Sunday constraints.
rows.suffix: suggest categories for the remaining time.
rows.combined: Plan my week around work from 9 to 6, keep Sunday free, and suggest categories for the remaining time.

manualReview.note: Preserves work hours and the free Sunday.

rows.prefix: Plan vegetarian dinners for two people with 20 minutes of cooking time, using
rows.criterion: Continue a practical meal request without changing people, diet or time.
rows.combined: Plan vegetarian dinners for two people with 20 minutes of cooking time, using simple, easy-to-find ingredients.

manualReview.note: Keeps the vegetarian diet, people count and cooking-time limit.

rows.prefix: Explain photosynthesis to a child in simple words, with
rows.criterion: Ask for an accessible explanation, not answer the science question.
rows.combined: Explain photosynthesis to a child in simple words, with a short, clear example.

manualReview.note: Asks for an accessible example without answering the task.

rows.prefix: Help me practise for a retail job interview by
rows.criterion: Suggest an interview-practice method without inventing experience.
rows.suffix: asking me one question at a time.
rows.combined: Help me practise for a retail job interview by asking me one question at a time.

manualReview.note: Provides an interview practice method in the user voice.

rows.prefix: Help me follow up with a supplier about a late order, without inventing a delivery date, and
rows.criterion: Continue an honest supplier update request.
rows.combined: Help me follow up with a supplier about a late order, without inventing a delivery date, and keeping the tone professional.

manualReview.note: Preserves honesty about unknown delivery dates.

rows.prefix: Help me plan a chatbot that answers questions about my products, without
rows.criterion: Continue the chatbot task, not a study template or an assistant answer.
rows.combined: Help me plan a chatbot that answers questions about my products, without inventing details about those products.

manualReview.note: Stays on product-chatbot instructions and avoids invented product facts.

rows.prefix: Помоги подготовиться к NCLEX за три месяца, добавь
rows.criterion: Russian continuation about exam practice, no invented schedule or guarantee.
rows.combined: Помоги подготовиться к NCLEX за три месяца, добавь категории тем для повторения.

manualReview.note: Russian study-topic continuation retains NCLEX and three months.

rows.prefix: Помоги ответить недовольному клиенту спокойно, не обещая возврат денег, и
rows.criterion: Russian customer reply that respects the no-refund-promise boundary.
rows.combined: Помоги ответить недовольному клиенту спокойно, не обещая возврат денег, и не придумывая фактов о ситуации.

manualReview.note: Preserves the no-refund promise boundary and factual reply.

rows.prefix: Составь план недели, оставь воскресенье свободным и
rows.criterion: Russian weekly-planning continuation with room for rest.
rows.combined: Составь план недели, оставь воскресенье свободным и предложи категории для остальных дней.

manualReview.note: Keeps Sunday free and plans the remaining days.

rows.prefix: Объясни, что такое сложный процент, простыми словами и
rows.criterion: Russian explanation request; no invented financial recommendation or figures.
rows.combined: Объясни, что такое сложный процент, простыми словами и с коротким примером.

manualReview.note: Russian request for a short explanatory example, no financial claim.

rows.prefix: Помоги спланировать поездку с бюджетом 300 долларов, учитывая
rows.criterion: Continue travel planning without inventing the destination or travel dates.
rows.combined: Помоги спланировать поездку с бюджетом 300 долларов, учитывая возможные категории расходов.

manualReview.note: Retains the supplied budget and considers expense categories.

rows.prefix: Предложи идеи подарка для друга, опираясь на
rows.criterion: Russian gift request; no invented age or personal interests.
rows.suffix: то, что я о нём расскажу.
rows.combined: Предложи идеи подарка для друга, опираясь на то, что я о нём расскажу.

manualReview.note: Explicitly waits for the friend details instead of inventing interests.

rows.prefix: Ayúdame a preparar un examen en tres meses con
rows.criterion: Natural Spanish study-request continuation.
rows.suffix: un plan de estudio claro y flexible.
rows.combined: Ayúdame a preparar un examen en tres meses con un plan de estudio claro y flexible.

manualReview.note: Natural Spanish flexible study-plan continuation.

rows.prefix: Necesito escribir un correo para pedir más tiempo, sin explicar mi motivo personal, y
rows.criterion: Spanish email request retaining privacy and avoiding an invented excuse.
rows.suffix: manteniendo un tono profesional y respetuoso.
rows.combined: Necesito escribir un correo para pedir más tiempo, sin explicar mi motivo personal, y manteniendo un tono profesional y respetuoso.

manualReview.note: Spanish professional email preserves the private reason.

rows.prefix: Planifica mi semana y deja el domingo libre para
rows.criterion: Spanish weekly plan; keep Sunday for rest or personal time, not work.
rows.combined: Planifica mi semana y deja el domingo libre para lo que surja.

manualReview.note: Spanish personal-time continuation keeps Sunday free.

rows.prefix: Planifica comidas vegetarianas para dos personas usando
rows.criterion: Spanish vegetarian meal planning without invented dietary requirements.
rows.combined: Planifica comidas vegetarianas para dos personas usando ingredientes de temporada disponibles.

manualReview.note: Retains Spanish vegetarian planning for two people.

rows.prefix: Ayudame a preparar una entrevista de trabajo con
rows.criterion: Spanish without accents in the prefix; continue interview practice.
rows.suffix: preguntas claras de una en una.
rows.combined: Ayudame a preparar una entrevista de trabajo con preguntas claras de una en una.

manualReview.note: Recognizes unaccented Spanish and asks one interview question at a time.

rows.prefix: Explica este tema con palabras sencillas y
rows.criterion: Spanish accessible explanation request, not a full answer.
rows.combined: Explica este tema con palabras sencillas y ejemplos claros.

manualReview.note: Spanish clear examples continue the explanation request.

manualReviewSummary.method: Manual reading of every combined request against the stated criterion; not an independent human usability test or a guarantee of future model behavior.
